out.description: Output file path, relative to the surface root. export image supports {name}, {frame} (zero-based), {frame1} (one-based), {layer}, {tag}, {tagframe} (zero-based within tag), and {slice}; integer frame fields accept widths such as {frame:02}. Other export subcommands use literal paths.
out.title: Out

overwrite.description: Replace existing output files when true.
overwrite.title: Overwrite

allow_invalid.description: Explicitly export even when validation has errors, recording a warning.
allow_invalid.title: Allow Invalid

data_out.description: Optional sheet/tileset metadata JSON output path, relative to the surface root.
data_out.title: Data Out

data_format.description: Sheet metadata shape: cybersprite, filename-keyed json-hash, or ordered json-array.
data_format.title: Data Format

layout.description: Item layout: horizontal, vertical, fixed rows/columns, or deterministic packed shelves.
layout.title: Layout

columns.description: Maximum item columns for rows layout.
columns.title: Columns

rows.description: Maximum item rows for columns layout.
rows.title: Rows

frames.description: Frame selection: zero-based index/list, all, range 0-3, or tag:name; omission uses all frames.
frames.title: Frames

tag.description: Tag ID or unique name selecting the frame range.
tag.title: Tag

layers.description: Layer references to include; omission uses the operation default selection.
layers.title: Layers

exclude_layers.description: Layer references excluded from sheet rendering.
exclude_layers.title: Exclude Layers

include_hidden.description: Include layers whose visibility flag is false.
include_hidden.title: Include Hidden

split_layers.description: Create separate sheet items for individual selected layers.
split_layers.title: Split Layers

split_tags.description: Create separate item sequences for tags.
split_tags.title: Split Tags

split_slices.description: Create separate cropped items for slices.
split_slices.title: Split Slices

scale.description: Integer nearest-neighbor scale; auto fits previews within their size limit.
scale.title: Scale

trim.description: Remove transparent borders and retain original bounds in sheet metadata.
trim.title: Trim

ignore_empty.description: Omit items containing only transparent pixels.
ignore_empty.title: Ignore Empty

merge_duplicates.description: Share identical entries instead of keeping duplicates.
merge_duplicates.title: Merge Duplicates

border.description: Transparent integer padding around the outer sheet edge.
border.title: Border

spacing.description: Integer gap between neighboring sheet items.
spacing.title: Spacing

inner.description: Transparent integer padding inside every sheet item.
inner.title: Inner

power_of_two.description: Round sheet dimensions up to powers of two.
power_of_two.title: Power Of Two

color_mode.description: Write palette-indexed or full RGBA output.
color_mode.title: Color Mode

flatten.description: Require exact palette closure (strict) or explicitly map to nearest palette colors.
flatten.title: Flatten

compression.description: PNG compression: deterministic stored blocks or environment-dependent zlib bytes.
compression.title: Compression

item_name.description: Metadata filename template using name, frame, frame1, layer, tag, slice, or tagframe placeholders.
item_name.title: Item Name
